items.md: Can you explain the attention mechanism in details by comparing it with the perceptron layer using the same notation to show why it is a weighted average of other position, specially showing me the case where the last token is being predicted (LLMs training procress). Add the explanation as a foldable box and only mention there is a box to check in the audio. You should not skip any details in the explanation but explain it step by step to a high-school audience.

quote: Every position takes a weighted average of information from other positions, with large weights for the positions that matter. The weights come from how well a “query” vector at one position matches a “key” vector at another Vaswani et al. 2017, pp. 3–4.
suffix: To predict text from left to ri
